bio.text: Jon Ossoff is the U.S. Senator from Georgia; he assumed office on January 20, 2021, and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
He was born in Atlanta in 1987, earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University's School of Foreign Service in 2009 and a master's degree from the London School of Economics in 2013.
Before the Senate he led a small business that produced investigative journalism, and he worked as a congressional aide to Rep. Hank Johnson; he lives in Atlanta with his wife and two daughters.
